title: Stats in AAPS and Pump are not the same  -  Dev AIMI
symptom: The AAPS stats are showing 2 lines for 30/11 and many of the values from the pump stats do not agree with the AAPS stats. There been 3 cannula changes during this time, each one using a 0.4 unit prime that is done from the pump while the pump is disconnected.
cause: The issue appears to be related to the end of British Summer Time on 30 Oct, causing double entries for that date and incorrect display of daily bolus and carbs data for the following week until the extra day rolled out of the 8-day statistics window.
fix: The issue was improved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/0ff8161cda29477d2c179332702d6d28948febf0
evidence_quote: I can confirm in my case as soon as the TDD Statistics section stopped showing '8 days' (ie: the 2 entries for end of BST on 30 Oct rolled over) all the days since then that were showing incomplete/incorrect data are now showing the correct data.
